column4: in Git Bash an awk -v pattern with a backslash escape ('Test\.java') warns and drops the escape, and an awk gsub replacement needs four backslashes for one: use bracket classes ('Test[.]java', gsub(/[.]/, "[.]")) in map-driven scripts; and GNU sed in Git Bash strips the CR of javap's CRLF output, so both javap sides go through tr -d '\r' before diff
